title: Interpretable Causal Discovery via Causal-Effect Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2608.12640v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Causal discovery aims to uncover the underlying causal relationships given data generated from a system. The goal, however, is not merely to predict causal edges given data, but also to be able to interpret and explain either observed or hypothesized phenomena, such as a particularly large causal effect. We consider this task of conditional causal discovery and cast it as a Bayesian inference problem, in which we target the posterior over causal graphs and parameters conditional on an event such as a causal-effect constraint. Unfortunately, this poses a computational challenge: existing approaches to Bayesian causal discovery struggle when the event has small posterior mass. To address this, we adapt rare-event estimation techniques to perform inference the joint graph-parameter space. Our method gradually drives a particle population toward the constrained region while maintaining samples that approximate the conditional posterior. Em

translated_title: 基于因果效应约束的可解释因果发现
translated_abstract: 因果发现旨在从系统生成的数据中揭示潜在的因果关系。然而，其目标不仅仅是根据数据预测因果边，还要能够解释和说明观察到的或假设的现象，例如特别大的因果效应。我们考虑这种条件因果发现任务，并将其视为贝叶斯推断问题，在该问题中，我们针对给定事件（如因果效应约束）下的因果图和参数的后验分布。不幸的是，这带来了计算挑战：当事件的后验质量较小时，现有的贝叶斯因果发现方法难以处理。为了解决这个问题，我们采用稀有事件估计技术来在联合图-参数空间上进行推断。我们的方法逐步将粒子群体推向约束区域，同时保持近似条件后验的样本。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因果效应约束的贝叶斯因果发现方法，通过稀有事件估计技术高效处理小后验质量事件，实现了对因果图的可解释性推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Bayesian causal discovery method based on causal-effect constraints, leveraging rare-event estimation to efficiently handle low posterior-mass events, enabling interpretable inference of causal graphs.
